subject: Price bridge matrix and scenario ladder for StellarPay decision
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: James Tully <james.tully@stellarpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Price bridge matrix and scenario ladder for StellarPay decision

Hi James —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Per our conversation I pulled together a compact "price bridge" visualization that lays out three paths for a migration from your current vendor to Redwood: (1) simple per-token price match + one-time onboarding credit, (2) volume-banded discount + 12-month commitment, (3) hybrid: modest match + migration credits + technical onboarding support.

Attached: price-bridge-matrix-v1.xlsx (summary + line-item assumptions) and a one-page PDF that shows how each scenario affects month 1 vs month 6 unit economics.

Quick clarifying asks so we can tighten the matrix:
- Your expected peak monthly generation tokens for the pilot (est. range is fine).
- Whether you require data residency in us-east for the pilot.
- Any mandatory termination/exit constraints we should model (e.g., 60-day notice for your current provider).

If you're open, we can run a short split: we propose a 90-day pilot under Plan A (price-match + $75k migration credit), then a go/no-go decision with an enforced step function to Plan B or C. That lets us demonstrate cost parity quickly while protecting Redwood on ramp economics.

Would tomorrow 10am PT work for a 20-min call to sign off on the assumptions?

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0104

Attachments: price-bridge-matrix-v1.xlsx, baseline-vs-match-scenarios.pdf
From: James Tully <james.tully@stellarpay.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Price bridge matrix and scenario ladder for StellarPay decision

Laura —

Thanks for this. Quick answers: pilot peak ~120M gen tokens / month (we expect burst to 200M during promos). Data residency: us-east required for payments workloads. Current vendor has a 45-day notice on enterprise plan, plus they offer an onboarding credit we might be able to leverage.

A couple things we care about before committing to a call:
- Can Redwood match on cost when adjusted for KV-cache hit assumptions? Our stack gets ~18% cache hit on customer prompts.
- Are migration credits refundable if we fail to hit baseline volumes? (we prefer credits that can be applied to future usage)

If you can send a matrix that shows "net unit cost after credits & cache" for the three scenarios, that will speed approvals. Happy 10am PT tomorrow if that helps.

—James
James Tully
Head of Platform Engineering | StellarPay
james.tully@stellarpay.com

>
> Thanks for this. Quick answers: pilot peak ~120M gen tokens / month (we expect burst to 200M during promos). Data residency: us-east required for payments workloads. Current vendor has a 45-day notice on enterprise plan, plus they offer an onboarding credit we might be able to leverage.
>
> A couple things we care about before committing to a call:
> - Can Redwood match on cost when adjusted for KV-cache hit assumptions? Our stack gets ~18% cache hit on customer prompts.
> - Are migration credits refundable if we fail to hit baseline volumes? (we prefer credits that can be applied to future usage)

Thanks James — great context and clear asks. Two quick notes:
1) Cache hits: our "net unit" calculator in the attached sheet has a cache factor input. For 18% KV hit we show Plan A net unit = $0.0009/token, Plan B = $0.00072/token (with 12-mo commit), Plan C hybrid = $0.00078/token + $60k onboarding credit. I'll highlight those rows for you.
2) Credits: we typically structure migration credits as non-refundable but fully transferable within the account and usable against future consumption up to 24 months. For enterprise deals we can make them refundable on a case-by-case basis with legal approval — that's where Marissa and Aditya come in.

I'll keep the 10am PT slot on the calendar. If it's helpful, Marissa can join to speak to legal/credit flex.

Best,
Laura

Attachments: price-bridge-matrix-v1.xlsx (marked cache=18%), baseline-vs-match-scenarios.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Price bridge matrix and scenario ladder for StellarPay decision

Laura / Aditya —

Forwarding James' responses and Laura's net-unit calc. Quick internal ask: James is asking for two commercial flex points we can approve quickly: (A) refundable migration credit vs non-refundable transferable credit, and (B) a short-term volume band that gets them price parity given 18% cache.

My suggested playbook (fast path):
- Offer a refundable migration credit up to $50k that becomes non-refundable after they hit 60 days of production at baseline volumes. Rationale: reduces procurement friction while limiting Redwood exposure.
- Offer price parity band for months 1–3 at up to 150M tokens (i.e., match effective net-cost). If they exceed 150M we switch to Plan B pricing automatically.

If Aditya signs off we can commit to that on the call and follow with a short amendment/DocuSign. Sean — can you confirm whether this is within current uplift/discretion?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Price bridge matrix and scenario ladder for StellarPay decision

Marissa / Laura —

I like the guardrails. Approve refundable credit up to $50k with the conversion condition (60 days at baseline). Approve the parity band to 150M tokens for months 1–3; if they hit >150M in a single month we transition to Plan B pricing and reconcile credits pro-rata.

Sean — please prepare a one-paragraph contract amendment and a DocuSign template we can send immediately after the call. Laura — go ahead and confirm the 10am PT meeting and state we can sign a short amendment post-call.

Aditya Rao
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
